g.text: NCT04003610 development study | 372 simulated participants compared with 7 participants enrolled in the trial

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #242d37

g.text: A Age distribution of the simulated cohort

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #40566c

g.text: Simulated cohort: mean age 38.7 years; 21 of 372 (6%) aged 57-84; 17 under 18.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #40566c

g.text: Drawn from simulated patients not ruled out by the checkable criteria; 37 criteria per patient, including the age limit, could not be checked.

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #40566c

g.text: Realised arms: expected 3.07 of 7; observed 2; P(at most 2) = 0.40

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #40566c

g.text: Simulated standard care pools the simulation's two standard-care arms to match the registry group (gemcitabine-carboplatin or pembrolizumab).

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #40566c

g.text: Serious-event probabilities depend on the treatment arm only, not on age, sex or race. With realised arm sizes of 1 and 6, these comparisons are descriptive.
